question: is the gen1 per-swath vertical offset a constant, or a function of across-track (scan-angle) position that the constant averages over?

inputs.role: pipeline corrections: grid geometry, per-swath internal alignment, geoid datum, drift curves
per-return gen1 CSF ground offsets to the gen2 surface, slope-normal mm, with the four registration terms
pipeline corrections: grid geometry, per-swath internal alignment, geoid datum, drift curves
per-return gen1 CSF ground offsets to the gen2 surface, slope-normal mm, with the four registration terms

params.name: min_cell_line
params.why: 1 is the definitional floor -- a median needs one value, so this imposes NO cut at all. The repo's boresight.estimate_boresight uses 3; that value is run as a sensitivity in section 9 and both answers are reported.

masks.name: elba_fulldensity reference cells
masks.defn: refcells.reference_cells() at its repo defaults: divide cells, |curv|<=0.015, slope<12 deg, no building returns, not clear-cut, not blufftop margin, |DoD|<=500 mm

masks.name: elbaext reference cells

columns.tile: derived-product directory the returns and cells come from
columns.pair: unordered flight-line pair A-B (point_source_id), A < B
columns.cells: overlap cells: reference cells covered by BOTH lines of the pair
columns.ret_A: gen1 returns of line A in those cells
columns.ret_B: gen1 returns of line B in those cells
columns.blocks: independent 50 m spatial blocks spanned by the overlap cells
columns.scan_A: mean scan angle of line A over the overlap cells, deg (signed, body frame)
columns.scan_B: mean scan angle of line B over the overlap cells, deg (signed, body frame)
columns.sum_tan: mean of tan(scan_A)+tan(scan_B) over the overlap; ~ +-S/h, the line spacing over flying height, and the sign of the side the pair shares
columns.dtan_lo: minimum of tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) over the overlap cells
columns.dtan_hi: maximum of tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) over the overlap cells
columns.dtan_sd: standard deviation of tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B): the leverage available
columns.k_mm: fitted intercept: between-line offset at tan(scan_A)=tan(scan_B), mm, positive = line A reads above line B
columns.k_se: cluster-robust standard error of k_mm, mm
columns.c_mm: fitted coefficient on tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B), mm per unit tangent
columns.c_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_mm, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_mmdeg: c_mm converted to mm per degree at small angle (c_mm * pi/180)
columns.r2: coefficient of determination of the pair's own fit
columns.medD: median between-line difference over the overlap cells, mm
columns.nmadD: normalised MAD of the between-line difference, mm
columns.c_shared: single coefficient shared by all pairs, mm per unit tangent
columns.W: cluster-robust Wald statistic for the stated restriction
columns.df: degrees of freedom of the Wald statistic
columns.p: upper-tail probability of W under chi-squared with df
columns.rss: residual sum of squares of the pooled fit, mm^2
columns.returns: gen1 returns of that swath on the reference cells
columns.slope_mmdeg: OLS slope of the response on scan_angle within the swath, mm/deg
columns.slope_se: cluster-robust standard error of that slope, mm/deg
columns.scan_sd: standard deviation of scan_angle within the swath, deg
columns.scan_mean: mean scan_angle within the swath, deg
columns.corr_ks: correlation between the fitted constant and slope of that swath's regression; |corr| -> 1 means the two are not separable
columns.resid_mmdeg: the same slope after subtracting the shared roll term, mm/deg
columns.dz_elba: elba per-swath dz re-referenced to swath 135, mm
columns.dz_ext: elbaext per-swath dz re-referenced to swath 135, mm
columns.disagree: dz_elba - dz_ext, mm: the tile-to-tile disagreement to be explained
columns.mean_dtan_elba: mean tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) sampled by elba in that pair's overlap
columns.mean_dtan_ext: mean tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) sampled by elbaext in the same overlap
columns.pred_mm: disagreement predicted by the shared roll: c_shared * (mean_dtan_elba - mean_dtan_ext), mm
columns.bin_lo: lower edge of the tan(scan_A)-tan(scan_B) bin
columns.bin_med: median between-line difference in the bin, mm
columns.bin_se: cluster-robust standard error of that median, mm
columns.b_se_mmdeg: its bootstrap SE (cell resampling only -- optimistic), mm/deg
columns.b_pairsd: std of its per-pair roll estimates -- the honest uncertainty, mm/deg
columns.c_over_sumtan: c_mm divided by the pair's mean sum_tan; constant across pairs if the error is EVEN in scan angle
columns.offset: which offset column the estimator was run on
columns.min_cell_line: minimum gen1 returns required for a (cell, flight-line) median
columns.kept_pairs: cell-pair observations surviving the cut, both tiles pooled
